a2-unit-19.19.1 Grace Kelly:
Host: Welcome to Hollywood History. Today's story is about an American movie star who became a real princess: Grace Kelly.
Host: Grace Kelly was born in Philadelphia in nineteen twenty-nine. Her family was rich and famous in the city. After high school, she moved to New York and studied acting.
Host: In the nineteen fifties, she became a big Hollywood star. She made three movies with the director Alfred Hitchcock, and in nineteen fifty-five, she won an Oscar for Best Actress.
Host: That same year, she went to the Cannes Film Festival in France. During the trip, she visited the palace in Monaco, a very small country near France, and she met Prince Rainier the Third for the first time.
Host: They wrote letters to each other for months. In January nineteen fifty-six, they announced their engagement, and in April, they got married in Monaco. More than thirty million people watched the royal wedding on live TV.
Host: Grace didn't make any more movies. She became Princess Grace of Monaco. She and Rainier had three children: Caroline, Albert and Stephanie. As a princess, she worked with many charities, and she helped children and artists.
Host: In September nineteen eighty-two, she had a terrible car accident on a mountain road in Monaco. She died the next day. People in Monaco, in the United States and around the world felt very sad.
Host: Today, her son Albert is the Prince of Monaco. And people still remember the American actress who became a princess.
